feeds.title: Love Food Nourish
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Hope, I'm a food-loving New Zealand based Registered Naturopath. I love creating nourishing, healthy recipes that are delicious and simple to make! I love eating food, sharing food with others and I get a kick out of making food that I know is nutritious and healthy and turning it into something yummy!

feeds.title: Nourish & Tempt
feeds.description: I'm Danijela, a New Zealand Registered Nutritionist. Here, you'll find simple, nutritious recipes that (hopefully) tempt you into the kitchen; as well as musing on wellbeing. Whether you're a new or returning visitor, I hope my corner of the internet provides additional tools or inspiration on your own food journey.

feeds.title: Caroha
feeds.description: Delicious food from scratch. Take a seat at my table as I share homemade food from scratch, delicious wines and easy ways of turning meals into memories.

feeds.title: Green Goddess Blog
feeds.description: DIY recipes, natural products, eco tips, wellness articles, and the latest Eco News! The Green Goddess philosophy is about working with things from the earth that are in tune with our whole selves - mind, body, and soul.

feeds.title: Hope Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: My name is Emily Hope and I'm a qualified NZ Registered Nutritionist. The Hope Nutrition website was born out of a love for food, nutrition, and the power it has to better people's lives.

feeds.title: Verve Magazine » Food & Wine
feeds.description: Founded in 2001, Verve Magazine is a lifestyle publication that covers a range of topics, including food and wine. Its mission is to provide readers with insights into the latest food and wine trends, as well as information on the best places to eat and drink in Auckland. Verve Magazine's food and wine section features interviews with chefs and industry experts, as well as recipes and food-related news.

feeds.title: Good Magazine » Food-Drinks
feeds.description: Explore different food news, drink, wine, and recipes on our blog! Good is proudly New Zealand's leading and award-winning lifestyle and well-being publication for conscious consumers, driving positive conscience-living. Every issue of Good includes scrumptious seasonal recipes, creative projects, and gorgeous yet achievable home style ideas, as well as expert advice on well-being, parenting, and gardening.

feeds.title: Slow Food Auckland Blog
feeds.description: Slow Food aims to change the world through food and celebrates the love of food cultures, rituals, and traditions. It connects everyone through food that is ethically and locally grown, produced, prepared, and served. Read our blog to know more about food!

feeds.title: Beef + Lamb
feeds.description: Beef + Lamb New Zealand Inc is responsible for the domestic promotion of beef and lamb and is jointly funded by farmers, New Zealand retailers, and New Zealand processors. We also manage and promote the New Zealand Beef and Lamb Quality Mark, through regular auditing at every step in the production chain, ensuring the highest standards are maintained.

feeds.title: Shared Kitchen Blog
feeds.description: Real food from scratch. Shared Kitchen is a good blog started by Julie Biuso. It is an ongoing collaboration between longtime New Zealand food personality Julie Biuso and upstart food blogger Ilaria Biuso.

feeds.title: Homegrown Kitchen by Nicola Galloway Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Nicola Galloway, Homegrown Kitchen is my food blog where I share my recipes inspired by the garden and seasonal produce. I love making homemade desserts, sourdough bread, yogurt, preservatives & ferments from scratch. Read my blog to see the detailed recipes of my favorite foods and more!

feeds.title: My Kids Lick The Bowl
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Stacey! As a mum of four with a background in Human Nutrition and Dietetics, I know all too well that sometimes meal times can be stressful and that when it comes to their nutrition journey, not all kids are the same even when they grow up in the same family! I am here to support you with common sense evidence-based advice and fuss-free recipes.

feeds.title: NZ Nutrition Foundation
feeds.description: The New Zealand Nutrition Foundation is a professional, non-profit organisation that works in partnership with other charities, businesses and government departments to help Kiwis eat well no matter what their circumstances.

feeds.title: ProZone
feeds.description: The Zone works because it's not about denying the body food, focusing on one food group, or following rigid meal plans; the principles of the Zone are based on balanced nutrition, our body's hormonal response to food, and cutting-edge science. ProZone brings you clarity on many of the diet facts and myths out there. Good nutrition is actually very simple, once one learns to recognize the facts from fiction.

feeds.title: Cooking With Lei
feeds.description: Hello, welcome to my blog! My name is Lei. I grew up in China and have been living in New Zealand for over two decades. My passion for food and photography has led me to this space where I can share my recipes and express my artistic side.

feeds.title: ABC Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Our ABC Nutrition blog has all the latest nutrition information, tips, and recipes to help you be your healthy best. Established in 2008, ABC Nutrition has a team of qualified nutritionists & Registered Dietitians located around New Zealand, who believe in making nutrition easy and uncomplicated. We all have a passion for food and believe it is to be enjoyed, not feared.

feeds.title: Nicole's Nutrition Kitchen
feeds.description: Hi - I'm Nicole! I am a university-qualified Nutritionist, online course creator, foodie, and home-cook. With a passion for sharing no-nonsense, evidence-based health and nutrition information. With so much conflicting information to be found online, I aim to provide credible information without the hype. I help people to ditch diets and create a balanced relationship with food.

feeds.title: Nutrition Consultants Blog
feeds.description: We are leading providers of quality, professional advice on all aspects of diet and nutrition. We use the latest technology to understand your body make-up. This enables us to match your food requirements specifically to you, for the best possible weight loss or other outcomes.

feeds.title: NZ Nutritionals Blog
feeds.description: Discover the latest in health and wellness news from New Zealand Nutritionals. Our blog profiles the latest trends and popular products in the supplement industry. We are one of New Zealand's leading distributors and manufacturers of all health, wellness and beauty products.

feeds.title: Key Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Qualified Nutritionist helping you achieve your health and nutrition goals so you look and feel the best! Customised plans with face to face consultations and follow up sessions to ensure you are succeeding and maintaining a healthy lifestyle!

feeds.title: Kiwi Nutrition
feeds.description: Kiwi Nutrition was founded by Dr. Neil Van Geest. The idea to start a nutrition company came about when he experienced challenges finding clean, natural, and affordable protein powder to help his mother with her nutrition when she was diagnosed with cancer. Good nutrition is so important to our families health. That's why we set up an organization to provide nutritional products to New Zealanders looking to boost their dietary intake for their training or health needs.

feeds.title: Thrive Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: I am Tania Vincent. I've always been interested in the relationship between the food we eat and our health. After a 16-year career in the travel industry, I decided to follow my passion and began studying for a degree in Nutrition. My mission is to provide nutrition counseling that empowers my clients to develop a positive relationship with food and improve their health, and to provide these services in a non-judgemental and supportive setting.

feeds.title: Mind Your Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kim! I'm an NZ Registered Nutritionist and Master NLP Practitioner with a passion for helping women gain back their food freedom, health, and body confidence.

feeds.title: NTS Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: We are Kate and James. Our primary focus is on making nutrition sustainable and long-lasting, and we are firm believers in creating a realistic plan that suits each individual.

feeds.title: The Kiwi Country Girl Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Laura! I live on a farm in rural New Zealand with my husband Josh, our kids Sadie, Macey & Finlay, and our black lab Sage. We're all about simple & delicious, family-friendly recipes that are made from scratch as well as tasty treats! Find dessert, dinner, salads & sides, preservings, farmer-friendly good tips, and recipes! Simple, family-friendly recipes that are made from scratch! Plus preserving, farm & garden tips, and easy DIY projects!

feeds.title: Cafe Crawler Lucy
feeds.description: Here you can find the latest and greatest food reviews, 'top 10 best, chef & foodie extraordinaire interviews - and even a few cheeky self-made recipes chucked into the mix. The Cafe Crawler is your one-stop shop for food reviews, industry interviews & even some foodie news.

feeds.title: The Great New Zealand Baking Book Project Blog
feeds.description: The Great NZ Baking Book Project Blog is a food blog by Rocio, she loves to cook different kinds of food. Her goal is to cook all her recipes in The Great New Zealand Baking Book.

feeds.title: Food Lovers
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Helen Jackson, Foodlovers is a New Zealand-based food website. Find over 1200 recipes using fresh New Zealand ingredients, as well as cooking and food hints from NZ Foodie. Get to know about all the amazing places to eat and drink on my page.

feeds.title: ThisNZLife » Food
feeds.description: This NZ Life, a New Zealand-based publication that celebrates life in New Zealand, including its food culture. This NZ Life Magazine's food section features recipes, cooking tips, and insights into the world of food and drink. Its mission is to inspire and inform its readers to cook and enjoy great food using fresh, locally-sourced ingredients.

feeds.title: Jumpstart Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: I am Jenny, I love the power of food and how it interacts with our health, our mental state, and our social lives. I love seeing children grow and thrive with good food. Through my knowledge and experience of nutrition, I help families, listening to their concerns and helping solve the nutrition problems that are impacting their life. I can guide you through your nutrition journey, adding my knowledge to your experiences so we can get a clear plan on what will work or not.
